description:
This is a PDF of Lectures on Gas Theory in German language by Ludwig Boltzmann. The entire set of lectures have been translated o English by Stephen G. Brush. The book is divided into 2 parts and presents the scientific understanding and Boltzmann's intuition for the concept of atoms in the early part of  20th century. The book is a historical classic and is often regarded as a benchmark work.

I have no monetary benefits from this work & it is intended for non-commercial uses only.
